VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence doesn't show the actual code fix. There's no diff demonstrating the race condition was addressed, no test specifically exercising concurrent token-refresh, and no proof the "small guard" correctly handles the race. Passing tests and unchanged dependencies satisfy criterion (2) and the test-count portion of (1), but "the bug is fixed" is unverified—the existing 64 tests could pass without any test that would have caught the original race. Request the code diff and a concurrency test before passing.
